comments.author: Simon
comments.text:
Hi Jess, Have a look at these lessons related to education: http://ielts-simon.com/ielts-help-and-english-pr/2011/07/ielts-speaking-part-3-lessons-topic.html http://ielts-simon.com/ielts-help-and-english-pr/2011/06/ielts-speaking-part-2-describe-a-lesson.html http://ielts-simon.com/ielts-help-and-english-pr/2011/03/ielts-speaking-part-3-longer-answers.html

The examiner doesn't say "introduce yourself", but he/she will ask some easy questions at the beginning. For example: http://ielts-simon.com/ielts-help-and-english-pr/2011/04/ielts-speaking-work-or-study.html
